hero.title: A private AI workspace for your whole company.
hero.text: You choose the models. You keep the keys. Your team gets one place to work with AI that you manage, measure and control.

models.title: Your models, your keys
models.text: Connect the gateway and the providers you already trust. Credentials stay on the server, never on a laptop.

teams.title: One workspace for every team
teams.text: People join by invitation, belong to departments and see exactly the models you publish for them.

usage.title: Usage you can read
usage.text: See who uses what and what it costs, per company, model and day, without exporting anything.

download.title: Download for Windows
download.text: The desktop app connects to your company workspace. Sign in with the account your administrator created for you.
